in_sanskrit.name: Khokan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the village
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Khokan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules over the village and its people.

in_hindi.name: Khokan
in_hindi.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the village
in_hindi.long_meaning: Khokan एक हिंदू नाम है जो भारतीय संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who rules over the village and its people.

in_tamil.name: Khokan
in_tamil.meaning: இந்து பெயர் என்று பொருள் Lord of the village
in_tamil.long_meaning: Khokan ஒரு இந்து பெயர் ஆகும், இது இந்திய கலாச்சாரத்தில் ஆழமான ஆன்மீக முக்கியத்துவத்தைக் கொண்டுள்ளது। One who rules over the village and its people.

in_telugu.name: Khokan
in_telugu.meaning: హిందూ పేరు అంటే Lord of the village
in_telugu.long_meaning: Khokan ఒక హిందూ పేరు, ఇది భారతీయ సంస్కృతిలో లోతైన ఆధ్యాత్మిక ప్రాముఖ్యతను కలిగి ఉంది। One who rules over the village and its people.

in_marathi.name: Khokan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the village
in_marathi.long_meaning: Khokan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who rules over the village and its people.

in_bengali.name: Khokan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the village
in_bengali.long_meaning: Khokan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who rules over the village and its people.
